scope: TB-L10 numerical/compiler qualification and TB-L11 bounded runtime ownership adoption only

entries.claim: Scientific numerical comparison is fail-closed by variable class and evidence role: exact/discrete contracts require exact equality, nonexact floating scientific differences require a separately qualified numerical policy, and B1 evidence cannot be relabelled as independent B2 reference evidence.
entries.failure_semantics: Any hidden tolerance, evidence-role relabelling, vacuous comparison or auto-acceptance of an unqualified scientific difference fails the contract.

entries.claim: Scientific reference capture requires unrounded values with explicit precision metadata and floating round-trip evidence; representation and scientific comparison remain separate layers, and packet completeness does not imply numerical equivalence.
entries.failure_semantics: Missing precision metadata, non-round-trip floating capture, post-hoc scope selection or rounded-report substitution fails the evidence contract.

entries.claim: A numerical policy is qualified only inside its explicitly derived domain and precision envelope; outside-envelope use fails closed, no hidden epsilon is created, and floating-point evaluation order or a justified equation-derived bound must be fixed before bitwise production binding.
entries.failure_semantics: Applying a domain-bounded policy outside its qualified envelope, inventing a tolerance from residual magnitude, or claiming bitwise binding without FP-order qualification fails the contract.

entries.claim: A runtime working value consumed as current-call or current-step information requires an explicit valid producer before first read and an explicit lifetime class; silent stack persistence or incidental compiler behaviour is not valid ownership.
entries.failure_semantics: Undefined first read, implicit persistence, ambiguous producer lifetime or observer mutation fails the runtime ownership invariant.

entries.claim: A shared cross-compiler and optimization qualification matrix for representative scientific and control-flow coordinates is not yet qualified.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: no repository-wide compiler or optimization equivalence claim may be inferred from isolated workunit probes.

entries.source_identity: ANIMO-TB01 architecture/runtime coverage requirement plus bounded BUILDQ/RUNTIMEQ evidence
entries.claim: Repository-wide runtime initialization, producer/consumer, lifetime and task-order invariants across all active subsystems are not yet comprehensively qualified.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: subsystem-specific runtime evidence cannot be generalized to whole-model runtime correctness.
